notes: «بعثني محمد بن القاسم إلى البراء يسأله» makes Yunus the asker and Bara' the one asked, whose answer is the saying (rules 5, 6); Muhammad b. al-Qasim only sent him, so he stays in the scene.
The dashed gloss «- رجل من ثقيف مولى محمد بن القاسم -» is left out (rule 1).

fixes.reason: The text writes «أبو يعقوب الثقفي» as the third link; the HKG route writes a different name in that place.
